amends.unchanged: the original file is not edited; every other gate (static, behavioural, regression pins, stopRule) stays exactly as registered

authority.d20Method: Owner 2026-10-20: use the real career rulesets with the formal rules and player conditions; seed-derived layouts, never forced; fixed seed order until each layout has >= 1000 valid seeds; the same seeds paired v20/v21; no outcome-based selection; overall + m4 stratified analysis; record why the original could not be executed, the method, n and limits; commit the revised registration and pass an independent review before measuring; tool twins only as supplementary diagnostic; thresholds not relaxed; no coefficient tuning
authority.seedRangeAndNormalisation: Owner 2026-10-20: supplementary seeds from 9101 approved (C8 reserve 6001-7000 untouched); counting unit = Live-normalised effectiveSeed, seeds mapping to the same effectiveSeed are never independent samples; 5001-6000 de-duplicated (6000 maps to 6001 and is excluded); odd sequence allowed; >= 1000 distinct valid effectiveSeeds per layout; estimates re-computed before running. This approval covers the seed range and normalisation only.
authority.m4Stratum: Owner 2026-10-20: m4 stratum STOP only on paired z >= 3 (worsening); worse_pp >= 5 is always reported as OWNER_REVIEW, never an automatic pass
authority.representativeness: Owner 2026-10-20: accepted with disclosure — this is 'formal career rulesets + formal assembly path + fixed tool roster and squad', never described as 'real career'

whyRevised: The original sideBias (career.v21 vs career.v20, STANDARD and SWAPPED each n = 1000 on seeds 5001-6000) cannot be executed literally: production rulesets have objectiveLayout bySeed and matchSetup pins it to the seed-derived layout (tool.forcedLayout is rejected for production), so one seed cannot run under both layouts. The tool-twin substitute (balanceTool.v20/v21 with forced layouts) was rejected by the Owner as the formal gate.

sideBias.rulesetResolution: resolveLiveRuleset with the featureFlags of tools/fixtures/match_golden_v20.json (career.v20); same flags + mobaTacticalDirectorV21=true (career.v21); the resolved rulesetId must equal the arm, otherwise the run fails
sideBias.path: Live assembly path: prepareLiveMatch (src/useLocalServer.js) -> buildLiveMatchSetup -> assembleMatch; no tool overrides

inputs.players: match_golden_v20.json inputs.players + inputs.lineup (player stats on blue only, the career rule playerStatSides = blue)
inputs.roster: moba_items_balance_runner mirroredRoster(seed) (same heroes on both sides, spells from buildLoadout), app-row shape via tools/lib/liveGolden.mjs appRoster
inputs.blueTactic: tactic-book binding of template std with no choices (bindTacticPlanToCurrentVersions(createTacticPlan({templateId:'std'}).plan)), the current new-match path. Reason: with no blue tactic the Live path never calls configureMatch, so the red style is never applied and v20/v21 would be identical by construction (controller probe 2026-10-20). A match without a tactical director fails the seed before ticking.
inputs.opponent: AI_TEAMS[seed % AI_TEAMS.length] (fixed assignment, independent of outcome); red tactic = mobaTacticForTeamStyle(team.style), the Live source
inputs.layout: not set; derived by the setup from the engine seed (objectiveLayoutForSeed(effectiveSeed))

sideBias.tick: dt 0.5 s, stop at engine over or 3600 s (same as the behavioural study)

seedOrder.unit: effectiveSeed = normalizeLiveSeed(seed, 'session'); every counted sample has a distinct effectiveSeed; the tool throws if a walked seed is not its own effectiveSeed or repeats one
seedOrder.why: Odd seeds only: an odd seed is its own effectiveSeed, so every sample has a distinct engine seed (even seed 2k would run engine seed 2k+1). 5001-5999 is the de-duplicated balance row of draft §1.3 (6000 maps to 6001 inside the C8 reserve and is excluded); it yields 249 STANDARD / 251 SWAPPED. The continuation starts at 9101 (Owner approval 2026-10-20), outside every range in the draft §1.3 table (9001-9100 = behavioural study).
seedOrder.stopRule: walk the sequence in ascending order; include every seed; stop after the first seed at which BOTH layouts have >= 1000 valid seeds
seedOrder.walkLimitRule: if the walk reaches 16000 without the target => incomplete, Owner decides (the sample threshold is never lowered)

circuitBreaker.rule: checked between chunks of 200 seeds and in the verdict: more than 20 invalid seeds, or (after >= 100 walked seeds) more than 2 % invalid => scheduling stops, verdict STOP(CIRCUIT_BREAKER), Owner decides

seedOrder.noSelection: no seed is dropped or chosen by outcome; the layouts are therefore unequal in n (SWAPPED keeps all its seeds up to the stop point)

sideBias.validSeed: both arms produced a record (prepareLiveMatch ok, tactical director present, no exception) and each record shows: rulesetId = the arm; engine seed = effectiveSeed; layout = objectiveLayoutForSeed(effectiveSeed); director mode/laneFrame = static/legacyMirror (career.v20) or core.v1/teamRelative (career.v21); red knobs tacticId = the tactic assigned to the seed. Outcome (win/loss/draw/timeout) never affects validity. An invalid seed is listed with its reason and the walk continues (subject to the circuit breaker). A worker exception is written to <arm>.errors.jsonl and the seed stays invalid on resume (deterministic engine; a transient failure is also kept, never retried selectively).
sideBias.metric: blue win rate; bias(ruleset, layout) = blueWinRate - 0.5. NEW RULE in this addendum (the original d was in {-1,0,1}): a match with no winner at 3600 s counts 0.5
sideBias.z: paired per-seed d = (win21 - win20) * sign(bias20) (sign(bias21) if bias20 = 0), d in {-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1} because of the draw rule; z = mean(d)/(sd(d)/sqrt(n)); sd = 0 => z = 0 when mean is 0
sideBias.thresholds: overall: unchanged, read from the original gates.sideBias.stop and gates.sideBias.warning (STOP: worse >= 5 pp or z >= 3 in the worsening direction or any new regression; WARN: worse >= 3 pp or |median duration21 / median duration20 - 1| > 0.10)

strata.overall: all valid seeds, per layout — the registered D-20 gate with the original STOP/WARN thresholds
strata.m4: valid seeds whose opponent style maps to tactic m4 (AI_TEAMS index 4, style objective; the only top/bot-asymmetric AI style), per layout. STOP only if the paired z in the worsening direction >= 3 (Owner 2026-10-20). worse_pp >= 5 => OWNER_REVIEW flag, always reported, the verdict becomes owner_review (never an automatic pass). No WARN for the stratum. Expected n 134 STANDARD / 152 SWAPPED.
strata.nonM4Identity: valid seeds whose opponent style maps to a top/bot-symmetric tactic: laneFrame swaps equal values, so career.v21 must reproduce career.v20 exactly (same winner and same duration) — any difference is an ANOMALY => STOP for Owner (independent review 2026-10-20 dumped knobs/directives for all 7 styles and found them JSON-identical for every non-m4 style)

sideBias.verdict: stop if: circuit breaker, any non-m4 anomaly, or (data complete and) an overall STOP or an m4 z STOP in either layout; else incomplete if the walk is not finished; else warn if an overall WARN; else owner_review if an m4 OWNER_REVIEW; else pass. Threshold flags are emitted only when the data is complete (no optional stopping on partial batches).
statisticalLimits: Dilution: only m4 opponents (about 1/7 of seeds) can differ between v20 and v21, so the overall worse_pp is diluted about 7x relative to the m4 stratum. This is the share of career matches exposed to the fix with the current uniform AI_TEAMS assignment: the overall figure answers the career-exposure question, the m4 stratum the style-specific question.

No pairing benefit in m4: a tiny knob change re-randomises the match (diagnostic seed 5002: red win 1501.5 s under v20, blue win 1023.5 s under v21), so v20/v21 outcomes on m4 seeds are close to independent and the paired z has roughly the power of an unpaired comparison. With n about 134/152 the standard error of mean(d) is about 5-6 pp; under no true effect P(worse_pp >= 5) is roughly 15-20 % per layout (about 30 % across both), which is why the Owner made worse_pp an OWNER_REVIEW flag and kept STOP on z >= 3 (false-alarm rate about 0.1 % per layout).
Outcome churn is expected: although the knob change is small, pairsChangedOutcome in the m4 stratum should be near 2p(1-p) of its pairs; churn by itself is not evidence of a bias change.

Family-wise rate: two layouts x two strata x several criteria (overall worse_pp/z/duration, m4 z, m4 OWNER_REVIEW); the overall z >= 3 and m4 z >= 3 criteria together have a family-wise false STOP rate below about 0.5 %; the OWNER_REVIEW and overall worse_pp criteria carry larger rates and are interpreted with the z values.

Intrinsic side bias is unmeasured here: blue has player stats and red does not (playerStatSides = blue), but probes showed red wins too; the size and sign of the starting bias are reported, not assumed. The gate compares v21 with v20 on the same seeds, not bias against zero.

Representativeness (Owner-accepted disclosure): formal career rulesets + formal assembly path + a fixed tool setup — blue std binding, mirrored rosters instead of drafts, uniform AI_TEAMS[seed%7] opponents (m4 exposure 1/7), one fixed golden squad with golden flags. Other squads, drafts, blue tactics and items strategies are not covered. Never described as 'real career'.
m4's only top/bot asymmetry among lane-keyed knobs is laneOffset (team-relative top -0.007, bot -0.057; gankWeights equal, no splitLane — controller probe and independent review 2026-10-20).
sideBias.twinDiagnostic: balanceTool.v20 vs balanceTool.v21 with forced STANDARD/SWAPPED (measure --study=sidebias-twin) may be run as a supplementary diagnostic only; it is never reported as the career acceptance and never decides the gate
sideBias.newRegression: unchanged: see the original gates.sideBias.newRegression and clarifications.newRegressionGates
